title: model-router pricing table
description: The shape a pricing.overrides file must have. Rates are USD per MILLION tokens, matching how every vendor publishes them, so transcribing from a verify URL is a copy rather than a conversion. The `unit` literal is required: a hand-written per-token table is rejected at load rather than silently producing costs a million times too low. Tables are never merged — an override row wins entirely, and a rate absent from that row is unpriced (null), not inherited.

pricingVersion.description: Stamped onto every event this table prices, so a stored row can name the table it was priced against. Bump it whenever a rate changes.

unit.description: Required literal. Guards against a per-token table being loaded as per-million.

currency.description: Only USD in calc_version 1. Any other value is rejected rather than converted.

models.description: Keyed by `${provider}:${model}`, never by model alone: the same model name served through ollama and through a cloud API cost wildly different amounts. A `${provider}:*` key prices a whole provider in one row.

model.description: The model the provider reports having served, or "*" for every model of this provider.

inputPerMTok.description: Uncached prompt tokens, USD per million. null means deliberately unpriced, which yields a NULL cost — never a zero.

cachedInputPerMTok.description: Cache-READ tokens, USD per million. Priced separately from inputPerMTok so a cached token is never charged at the full input rate.

outputPerMTok.description: Output tokens, USD per million. Thinking tokens are billed here too.

thinkingBilledAsOutput.description: Documents that thinking tokens use outputPerMTok rather than a rate of their own. calc_version 1 has no separate thinking rate.

verify.description: Where a human can check this rate. Required even when the rates are null, because a null rate is a prompt to act.

verifiedAt.description: ISO date a human last checked the rate against `verify`. null means never verified.

effectiveFrom.description: Reserved. Unused in calc_version 1; a rate change is expressed by bumping pricingVersion.
